summary: Etap-1 B-ZONE 2.0 full-stack test. Backend: 40/40 pytest passing (auth, users approval, projects, hours accrual engine, reports w/ weather, issues, deliveries, files upload/download, notifications, audit-log, role-enforcement, transcribe auth). Frontend: mobile viewport login, admin dashboard with 4 metrics + empty states, PL↔EN language toggle works, registration produces pending user, admin sees them in Users, project creation via /project-form succeeds and shows in Aktywne projekty list (metric-projects went 0→1), notifications feed populated by backend events. testID coverage good across screens. Console shows only benign expo warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents deprecation notices from RN Web).

minor.issue: Requires no role guard - fine for workers, but the query includes no company_id filter (works because ids are uuid-scoped). Not a bug in this single-tenant deployment.
Returned url is a relative path (/api/files/{id}/content). Frontend must prefix with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via existing fileUrl() helper — OK.

issues: All text properly wrapped in Text; touch targets ≥44px; contrast fine on dark theme; keyboard handling via KAV not directly verified on web preview but form inputs focus normally.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated — use 'boxShadow' (react-native-web). Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: multiple screens (login.tsx, index.tsx, etc.).
Warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: RN Web deprecation, likely inside a wrapper component.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (react-native-web deprecation) across styles.
Optional: replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents where used.
Consider surfacing a friendly error banner on failed transcription (currently maps to 502; UI just throws).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1370 lines — acceptable for Etap 1 but consider splitting into routers per resource (auth, users, projects, hours, reports, issues, deliveries, files, notifications) before scaling.
Password reset endpoint returns the raw token in response body — noted in code as MVP convenience; must be removed and emailed in production.
notify() catches push failures broadly — good; primary DB write still succeeds. Push provider correctly non-blocking with placeholder key.
clean() consistently strips _id; no MongoDB ObjectId leaks observed in any tested endpoint.
All routes correctly prefixed with /api; CORS wide-open which is fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ users/projects/reports/issues/deliveries and delete them in Test99Cleanup. One UI test left a residual pending user (test_ui_*) — safe to ignore or admin can approve/reject.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest uses shared module-level state dict; classes renamed Test01..Test99 to force execution order. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope which breaks cross-class shared state — use `-n 0` for these sequential integration tests. Admin creds admin@bzone.app / Admin12345!. Use non-reserved email TLDs (.com) as pydantic EmailStr rejects .test.
